name: GIMP
description_en:
GIMP is a free desktop image editor for photo retouching, compositing and image creation on GNU/Linux, macOS and Windows. It offers layers, editable effects, color-management tools and scripting/plugin extensibility. The official download page read lists stable version 3.2.6; the detailed workflow evidence here comes from the 3.2 manual.

Its important handoff distinction is between an editable XCF project and an exported image. XCF preserves the native editing state, while a delivery format can lose layer/effect information. Free GPL software permits commercial creative work, but that does not clear the rights to every photograph, font, plugin or other asset used in a design.
description_zh:
GIMP是用于照片修饰、合成及图像创作的免费桌面编辑器，支持GNU/Linux、macOS和Windows，提供图层、可调效果、色彩管理及脚本/插件扩展。实读官方下载列稳定版3.2.6，详细流程依据3.2手册。

交付时需区分可编辑XCF项目与导出图像：XCF保留原生编辑状态，交付格式可能损失图层/效果信息。GPL免费软件允许商业创作，但不自动解决所用照片、字体、插件或其他资产权利。

core_features.explanation_en: Retouch and combine images while keeping an XCF project for later editing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 修饰及合成图像，并保留XCF项目供后续编辑。

core_features.explanation_en: Eligible GEGL filters can remain adjustable in XCF; exporting merges those effects, including in PSD output.
core_features.explanation_zh: 符合条件的GEGL滤镜可在XCF保持可调，导出时会合并，包括PSD输出。

core_features.explanation_en: Save creates the native XCF project; Export produces another format with its own preservation limits.
core_features.explanation_zh: Save保存原生XCF项目，Export生成其他格式，各有保留限制。

pricing.summary_zh: GPLv3或后续版桌面软件免费，允许商用；未建立强制订阅，硬件/培训/可选插件或服务及资产权利另计。

sections.title_en: Keep a reusable project and a separate delivery image
sections.title_zh: 保留可复用项目，并另存交付图像
sections.en:
For an illustrative campaign graphic, open the approved photograph, compose the image/text elements and refine the relevant layers. Save the working project as XCF, then export the required web or print delivery format. Reopen both separately: the project should retain the intended editable components, while the export should be checked for size, transparency, profiles and visual appearance. This exercise was not executed.

The 3.2 manual says opening JPEG/PNG imports it into a new native project. Save uses XCF; Export handles other formats and does not change the project itself. XCF preserves native image information but not undo history, and many ordinary image viewers cannot read it. An exported asset therefore complements rather than replaces the working file and backup.
sections.zh:
例如活动图，可打开获准照片、组合图像/文字并调整相应图层。工作项目存为XCF，再导出所需网页或印刷格式；分别重新打开，检查项目可编辑组件，以及输出尺寸、透明度、配置文件及视觉效果。上述练习未执行。

3.2手册称打开JPEG/PNG会导入为新原生项目，Save使用XCF，其他格式用Export，导出不改变项目本身。XCF保留原生图像信息但不含撤销历史，许多普通查看器也不能读；导出资产应与工作文件及备份配套。

sections.title_en: Understand what remains editable after an effect
sections.title_zh: 理解效果处理后哪些仍可编辑
sections.en:
A layer effect is rendered over a single layer without permanently changing its pixels. The manual says most GEGL filters can be used this way; other filter/plugin types cannot automatically become layer effects. Effects can be edited, reordered, hidden or removed, and the stack is rendered from bottom to top, so order can change the result. Eligible effects and their settings persist in XCF after reopening.

Using Merge Filter or merging effects into the layer removes that adjustable stack. Export also merges effects even when the target, such as PSD, supports its own effects. Do not promise a collaborator editable GIMP effects merely because the file extension is PSD. Many live effects can slow rendering; test the real document before merging as a performance tradeoff and keep a separate editable original.
sections.zh:
图层效果叠加到单一图层，不永久改变其像素。手册称多数GEGL滤镜可这样使用，其他滤镜/插件不能自动成为图层效果。效果可编辑、排序、隐藏或删除，堆栈自下而上渲染，顺序可能改变结果；符合条件效果及设置在XCF重新打开后仍保留。

启用Merge Filter或将效果合并到图层会移除可调堆栈；导出也会合并，即使PSD等目标支持其自身效果。不能仅因扩展名PSD就承诺协作者获得可编辑GIMP效果。大量实时效果可能拖慢渲染，应以实际文档测试合并取舍，并保留独立可编辑原件。

sections.title_en: Check raw processing and color requirements explicitly
sections.title_zh: 明确核对RAW处理及色彩要求
sections.en:
The FAQ describes raw-camera processing through darktable or RawTherapee plugins, with a default raw-processing plugin preference. That is an external dependency path, not evidence that every camera RAWformat is handled natively or that a particular plugin/version works on the chosen machine. Test a representative camera file before adopting the workflow.

For CMYK, the FAQ distinguishes importing/exporting selected CMYK formats with conversion to/from RGB storage and soft-proof-related information from a native CMYK core image mode. It does not give a completion date for that native mode. Confirm the printer’s profile, separations, proofing and accepted output in a real prepress workflow; a CMYK picker or exporter alone does not establish full print-production parity.
sections.zh:
FAQ描述通过darktable或RawTherapee插件处理相机RAW，并提供默认RAW处理插件设置。这是外部依赖路径，不证明所有相机RAW格式都原生处理，也不证明特定插件/版本在目标机器可用，采用前应测试代表文件。

CMYK方面，FAQ区分部分格式导入/导出经RGB存储转换、软打样相关信息与原生CMYK核心图像模式，未给后者完成日期。应在实际印前流程确认印厂配置文件、分色、打样及接收格式；CMYK取色或导出本身不等于完整印刷生产能力。

sections.title_en: Choose the official package for the actual operating system
sections.title_zh: 为实际系统选择官方安装包
sections.en:
The read download page lists stable 3.2.6 dated September 10, 2026. Its macOS packages require macOS 11 Big Sur or newer and distinguish Intel/Apple Silicon; the Windows installer requires Windows 10 1903 or newer, while its Microsoft Store package has a different Windows 11/Server 2022 minimum. The AppImage lists Debian 13 or a newer distribution, and other Linux packaging options have their own environment requirements. These are package-specific source statements, not an installation test.

The project says it does not publish an Apple App Store package at this read. Use the official download information and integrity data rather than assume an identically named store listing is the project’s package. Match 3.x plugins/scripts and tutorials to the installed version; this research did not install software, run a script or establish compatibility with a specific third-party plugin.
sections.zh:
实读下载页列稳定版3.2.6，日期2026年9月10日。macOS包要求macOS11 Big Sur或更新，并区分Intel/Apple Silicon；Windows安装器要求Windows10 1903或更新，Microsoft Store包则另有Windows11/Server2022最低要求。AppImage列Debian13或更新发行版，其他Linux打包也有自身环境要求。这些是具体包的来源说明，不是安装测试。

项目在实读时称未发布Apple App Store包，应使用官方下载及完整性信息，不能假定同名商店条目就是官方包。3.x插件/脚本和教程需匹配安装版本，本次未安装、运行脚本或建立某第三方插件兼容性。

sections.title_en: Use free software commercially with separate asset rights
sections.title_zh: 商业使用免费软件，同时核对资产权利
sections.en:
The FAQ explicitly permits commercial use and identifies GPL v 3 or later for the program. Software redistribution/modification has GPL obligations; the license does not require an artist’s original output to become GPL merely because GIMP was used. Photographs, fonts, brushes and other inputs can still carry their own terms. The website’s Creative Commonsnotice is also separate from the application license. These are source summaries, not legal advice.

There is no mandatory application subscription established here. Training, hardware, storage, external raw tools, plugins or professional support can still cost money. GIMP fits local retouching/compositing and editable image work; teams needing a specific proprietary document round-trip or complete prepress workflow should test those requirements rather than assume full equivalence. The manual itself warns of outdated sections and omissions, so version-sensitive behavior remains subject to verification.
sections.zh:
FAQ明确允许商用，并将程序标为GPLv3或后续版本。软件再分发/修改有GPL义务，但艺术家的原创输出不会仅因使用GIMP就必须GPL；照片、字体、笔刷及其他输入仍可有独立条款。网站Creative Commons声明也不同于应用许可。上述为来源概括，不是法律意见。

本次未建立强制应用订阅，但培训、硬件、存储、外部RAW工具、插件或专业支持仍可能收费。GIMP适合本地修图/合成及可编辑图像工作；如需特定专有文档往返或完整印前流程，应实测而非假定等价。手册自身提醒可能有过时段落和遗漏，版本相关行为仍需核验。
